shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json && git log --oneline -5
find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | head -100
for f in app/page.tsx app/layout.tsx lib/db.js next.config.ts tsconfig.json __agent_eval__/run.mjs; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat "$f"; done

cat node_modules/next/package.json | head -5 && echo "--- next/cache exports ---" && cat node_modules/next/cache.js 2>/dev/null | head -40 && echo "--- cache.d.ts ---" && cat node_modules/next/cache.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40
ls node_modules/next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/ | grep -iE 'tag|revalid|cache|refresh'
cat node_modules/next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/revalidate.d.ts
cat node_modules/next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/revalidate.js

cat node_modules/next/dist/server/use-cache/cache-life-profile.js 2>/dev/null | head -60; echo "=== defaults ==="; grep -rn "max:" node_modules/next/dist/server/lib/cache-life.js 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/next/dist/server/lib/ | grep -i cache-life
grep -rn "cacheComponents" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.js | head -5; echo "=== use cache gate ==="; grep -rn "use cache\b" node_modules/next/dist/build/swc/options.js | head -20

grep -rln "cacheLifeProfiles\|defaultCacheLife\|'max'" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.js node_modules/next/dist/server/lib/*.js 2>/dev/null | head; echo "---"; grep -n -A6 "max: {" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.js | head -40
grep -rn "pendingRevalidatedTags" node_modules/next/dist/server/ --include=*.js | grep -v ".map" | head -20
grep -rn "use cache" node_modules/next/dist/build/swc/index.js 2>/dev/null | head -5; echo "=== gating errors ==="; grep -rn "cacheComponents" node_modules/next/dist/build/swc/options.js | head -20

grep -rn "useCache\b" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.js | head -5; echo "=== error msg ==="; grep -rn "To use \"use cache\"\|enable.*cacheComponents\|dynamicIO" node_modules/next/dist/server/config.js 2>/dev/null | head -10
sed -n 1215,1265p node_modules/next/dist/server/config.js
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -20
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -40

cp lib/db.js /tmp/db.js.bak && cat > lib/db.js <<'EOF'
let queryCount = 0

export async function getAllProducts() {
  // Simulate database delay
  await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 100))

  queryCount++
  console.log(`[db] getAllProducts query #${queryCount}`)

  return [
    { id: 1, name: `Laptop (query #${queryCount})`, price: 999 },
    { id: 2, name: 'Phone', price: 699 },
    { id: 3, name: 'Tablet', price: 499 },
    { id: 4, name: 'Headphones', price: 199 },
    { id: 5, name: 'Watch', price: 299 },
  ]
}
EOF
echo "patched db.js for instrumentation"

npm run build 2>&1 | tail -8 && (PORT=3123 npx next start > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 6 && curl -s localhost:3123 -o /tmp/p1.html -w "status=%{http_code}\n" && grep -o 'Laptop (query #[0-9]*)' /tmp/p1.html
for i in 1 2 3; do curl -s localhost:3123 | grep -o 'Laptop (query #[0-9]*)' | head -1; done; echo "=== form markup ==="; grep -o '<form[^>]*>.\{0,400\}' /tmp/p1.html

curl -s -X POST localhost:3123/ -F '$ACTION_ID_00bd8b11235701aa52143473ac8478b4747aa7631f=' -o /tmp/post.html -w "status=%{http_code} total_time=%{time_total}s\n" -D /tmp/post.headers; echo "=== response body: which query? ==="; grep -o 'Laptop (query #[0-9]*)' /tmp/post.html | head -2; echo "=== db log so far ==="; grep '\[db\]' /tmp/next.log

echo "--- GET immediately after sync ---"; curl -s localhost:3123 | grep -o 'Laptop (query #[0-9]*)' | head -1; sleep 1; echo "--- GET after 1s ---"; curl -s localhost:3123 | grep -o 'Laptop (query #[0-9]*)' | head -1; sleep 2; echo "--- GET after 3s ---"; curl -s localhost:3123 | grep -o 'Laptop (query #[0-9]*)' | head -1; echo "=== db log ==="; grep '\[db\]' /tmp/next.log
grep -A8 "Route (app)" /tmp/build2.log

pkill -f "next start" ; sleep 1; (PORT=3124 npx next start > /tmp/next2.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6
echo "--- baseline both views ---"
curl -s localhost:3124 | grep -o 'query #[0-9]*' | head -1
curl -s localhost:3124/tmp-check | grep -o 'CHECK:Laptop (query #[0-9]*)'
AID=$(curl -s localhost:3124 | grep -o '\$ACTION_ID_[a-f0-9]*' | head -1 | sed 's/\$ACTION_ID_//')
echo "--- sync via form POST (action $AID) ---"
curl -s -X POST localhost:3124/ -F "\$ACTION_ID_$AID=" -o /dev/null -w "status=%{http_code} time=%{time_total}s\n"
sleep 1; curl -s localhost:3124 -o /dev/null; curl -s localhost:3124/tmp-check -o /dev/null; sleep 2
echo "--- after sync: both views ---"
curl -s localhost:3124 | grep -o 'query #[0-9]*' | head -1
curl -s localhost:3124/tmp-check | grep -o 'CHECK:Laptop (query #[0-9]*)'
echo "=== db log (total queries) ==="; grep -c '\[db\]' /tmp/next2.log; grep '\[db\]' /tmp/next2.log
ps aux | grep -c "[n]ext-server"; (npx next start --port 3125 > /tmp/next3.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 7; curl -s localhost:3125 -o /dev/null -w "up=%{http_code}\n"

echo "--- baseline ---"
curl -s localhost:3125 | grep -o 'query #[0-9]*' | head -1
curl -s localhost:3125/tmp-check | grep -o 'CHECK:Laptop (query #[0-9]*)'
AID=$(curl -s localhost:3125 | grep -o 'ACTION_ID_[a-f0-9]*' | head -1 | sed 's/ACTION_ID_//')
echo "--- sync POST ---"
curl -s -X POST localhost:3125/ -F "\$ACTION_ID_$AID=" -o /dev/null -w "status=%{http_code} time=%{time_total}s\n"
sleep 1; curl -s localhost:3125 -o /dev/null; curl -s localhost:3125/tmp-check -o /dev/null; sleep 2
echo "--- after sync ---"
curl -s localhost:3125 | grep -o 'query #[0-9]*' | head -1
curl -s localhost:3125/tmp-check | grep -o 'CHECK:Laptop (query #[0-9]*)'
echo "=== db queries at runtime ==="; grep '\[db\]' /tmp/next3.log || echo "(none — all served from cache/prerender)"

echo "--- /tmp-check raw ---"; curl -s localhost:3125/tmp-check | grep -o 'CHECK:.\{0,40\}'; echo "--- / ---"; curl -s localhost:3125 | grep -o 'query #[0-9]*' | head -1; echo "=== total db queries ==="; grep -c '\[db\]' /tmp/next3.log

PID=$(ps -eo pid,args | grep '[n]ext-server' | awk '{print $1}'); echo "killing: $PID"; [ -n "$PID" ] && kill $PID; sleep 1
rm -rf app/tmp-check
cp /tmp/db.js.bak lib/db.js
echo "=== db.js restored ==="; cat lib/db.js
echo "=== git status ==="; git status --short
cat .gitignore; echo "=== tsconfig diff ==="; git diff tsconfig.json
npm run build 2>&1 | grep -E "Compiled|Route|○|error|Error" | head -10
git checkout tsconfig.json && echo "tsconfig reverted" && git diff --stat tsconfig.json
git status --short; echo "=== final diff ==="; git diff -- app next.config.ts
